newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls venture gets $300 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls venture gets $300 mln deal.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc said Thursday its Malaysian joint venture won a more than $300 million, five-year hospital support services contract.
The contract covers 71 hospitals operated by the Ministry of Health in Malaysia, Johnson Controls said.
To serve the facilities, the joint venture will manage a workforce totaling more than 3,500 staff, including 1,000 people previously employed by the Ministry of Health, the company said.
The contract is part of an agreement Faber Medi-Serve Sdn Bhd signed with the Ministry of Health at the end of 1996 to service the hospitals.

Effective January 1, 1997, Faber Medi-Serve signed a five-year sub-contract with PROPEL-Johnson Controls Sdn Bhd, Johnson Controls' joint venture company, of which it holds a 49 percent share, the company said.
Established in 1995, PROPEL-Johnson Controls is a Malaysian joint venture company with 51 percent ownership by Projek Penyelenggaraan Lebuhraya Bhd (PROPEL).
Johnson Controls provides automotive systems and controls.
